reading.ours: two units of arithmetic per iteration
reading.floor: one unit of arithmetic per iteration
reading.caveat: NOT A PRICE — an instrument check, and it is printed first because nothing below it means anything until it passes. The true ratio is a little UNDER 2: both sides pay the driving loop once, so the exact expectation is (2u + L) / (u + L) with L the loop and u one unit, which at sixteen dependent steps per unit puts it around 1.9. A reading below 1.5 means this process could not resolve a deliberate doubling, and the runner voids the report rather than printing prices under it.

reading.ours: one unit of arithmetic per iteration
reading.floor: the same body again, over its own copy of the same state
reading.caveat: NOT A PRICE — the noise floor. The two sides are identical code over identical, separately-allocated state, so the true ratio is 1.00 exactly and every departure from it printed here was produced by this machine at this moment. The rule that follows is the one the whole table is read under: NO RATIO CLOSER TO 1.00 THAN THIS GAP IS A READING. It also bounds the per-row noise figure, which is the same idea measured again inside every pair — each pair times its floor twice, once before our side and once after, and prints how far the two disagreed.

reading.ours: a frame of 16 writes, flushed, then the 16 derivations it moved read once each — deduped at the getter, through a shipped effect and a shipped settle
reading.floor: the same frame — deduped in the channel, by a dependent walk on the write and a recompute at the head of the frame
reading.caveat: THE BASELINE THE OTHER THREE ROWS EACH MOVE ONE AXIS AWAY FROM, and the ordinary arrangement: everything the frame touched is wanted, and it is read after the frame that announced it. Both arms write the same 16 rows through the same `OIMEntityCollection` and the same `OIMChannel`, both carry a real `OIMEffect` per reader, and both flush — so the write path, the leaf list and the frame are common and cancel. WHAT DIFFERS, PER FRAME: ours settles 16 derivations inside the effects the flush runs and then asks each again at the read, where `checkedAt*` stops it on two comparisons; the floor visits 32 dependents on the write path, of which 16 end on its frame stamp, recomputes the 16 it queued before the leaves run, and reads a field. OURS IS SHIPPED CODE AND THE FLOOR IS WRITTEN IN THIS FILE — the engine has no push to import — and the floor is given the design at its best: an array indexed by the root index rather than a hash probe, one reused queue, and an effect body that asks the node stamp before it runs. I EXPECT THIS ROW WITHIN 0.85x TO 1.15x [FIGURE STATED IN ADVANCE], because the two arms share everything except one walk each, in opposite places. A reading far outside that band is a reading to investigate before it is quoted.
